inv.desc_es:
Agencia inmobiliaria de MADRID - zona CARABANCHEL SAN ISIDRO -VISTALEGRE – CARPETANA
Vende Local comercial de 430m2 situado en Avenida Nuestra Señora de Valvanera. Dispone de 3 baños, uno de ellos con ducha, 1 Oficina y patio de uso privado. Dispone de VADO.

Tiene varios puntos a destacar:

- Calle comercial.
- En buen estado.
- Bajo a pie de calle con VADO.
- Patio de uso privado.
- Cercanía a General Ricardos, calle la Oca y Vía Carpetana.
- Cercanía a Madrid Río.

Zona perfecta para comercios con bastante movimiento de personas en la zona, A 15 MINUTOS A PIE DE MADRID RÍO.

Fácil acceso a A42, M40, M30 Calle de Antonio López, General Ricardos, Hospital Gómez Ulla, a 5 minutos del metro Carpetana y Urgel.

Esta cercano a las calles comerciales como la Avenida de Nuestra Señora de Valvanera, calle Oca, Calle Laguna, calle General Ricardos y Via Carpetana, pero también rodeado de zonas verdes como es el parque de la Cuña Verde y el parque de San Isidro.

inv.desc_en:
MADRID Real Estate Agency - CARABANCHEL SAN ISIDRO - VISTALEGRE – CARPETANA area
Sells 430m2 commercial premises located on Avenida Nuestra Señora de Valvanera. It has 3 bathrooms, one of them with a shower, 1 office, and a private-use patio. It has a vehicle curb cut (VADO).

Several points to highlight:

- Commercial street.
- In good condition.
- Ground floor at street level with vehicle curb cut.
- Private-use patio.
- Proximity to General Ricardos, Calle la Oca, and Vía Carpetana.
- Proximity to Madrid Río.

Perfect area for businesses with plenty of foot traffic in the area, 15 MINUTES WALK FROM MADRID RÍO.

Easy access to A42, M40, M30, Calle de Antonio López, General Ricardos, Gómez Ulla Hospital, 5 minutes from Carpetana and Urgel metro stations.

It is close to commercial streets such as Avenida de Nuestra Señora de Valvanera, Calle Oca, Calle Laguna, Calle General Ricardos, and Vía Carpetana, but also surrounded by green areas such as the Cuña Verde park and San Isidro park.

VIRTUAL TOUR COMING SOON.

LEGAL NOTICE: We remind our clients that the information provided does not constitute an authentic binding or contractual offer. This advertisement is provisional, and the photographs and data included in it are subject to possible modifications, as a result of commercial, legal, or technical requirements or by express mandate of the property. The information contained herein seeks to reflect an orientation regarding the properties at the date of their publication. All content that appears is merely informative and approximate, and in no way has a contractual nature. Both the data, as well as the images and plans, may be subject to changes, so we invite you, if you require more exact and detailed information, to contact us and we will assist you as soon as possible. The contents are for informational purposes only and under no circumstances should they be used or considered as an offer for sale or financing, a request for an offer to purchase or finance, or a recommendation to carry out any other transaction, unless expressly indicated otherwise. The information and documentation to be offered in accordance with the provisions of Royal Decree 515/1989 (of April 21, regarding consumer protection regarding the information to be provided in the sale and leasing of homes), will be made available to potential buyers at the respective territorial offices managing the property.
